verdict.rationale: The docs confirm that `tofu plan -out=FILE` saves a plan artifact that can later be run by passing the file to `tofu apply`. Plan files can also be encrypted at rest, which helps when storing artifacts in CI. The drop-in Terraform compatibility claim suggests existing CI workflows carry over, but the pack never explicitly documents approval or non-interactive flags. missing for 10: documented -auto-approve/approval flags, explicit non-interactive/-input=false CI guidance, independent hands-on CI corroboration
